browser_evidence.reason: No sprint contract in this repo declares playwright_checks or design_checks, and e2e/ is empty. No browser layer was executed and none is claimed. The playwright and accessibility layers are not-applicable for group A, not untested.

entries.notes: 100% is 1/1 - the only line emitted per request is the middleware's truelend.access line. The whole-stream check is the stronger evidence: 71/71 lines parsed as JSON, including 4 uvicorn.error startup lines and 3 uvicorn.error WARNING lines emitted in-flight, and including lines whose request_id was adversarial (embedded quotes, TAB, 4000 chars, raw UTF-8). uvicorn.access is disabled rather than reformatted.

Generated id is 32-char uuid4 hex. Ids are distinct per request (23 distinct over the run) so the generator genuinely generates rather than returning a constant. ContextVar isolation holds under 30-way concurrency.
All 20 samples under the 1s contract criterion and under the 500ms project SLO. The ~200ms floor is Windows localhost connect overhead in curl, not server time.

interactions: stream capture off the real root StreamHandler
occurrence counting over the captured buffer
entries.notes: Proven at the logging-substrate level, not through an HTTP request: group A exposes only GET /health, which accepts no payload, so the AC's 'when the request is served' has no payload-carrying endpoint to exercise yet. Redaction is opt-in - it scrubs only values a caller wraps in redact_values(), so the AC's forward guarantee depends on every payload-handling story remembering to call it.

interactions: emission from a logger created AFTER configure_logging
entries.notes: Logger-level coverage is 100% of the 9 loggers registered at configure_logging time. Loggers created later get no logger-level filter, but the handler-level RedactionFilter catches their propagated records - verified by emitting from truelend.probe, created after configure_logging, and observing [REDACTED].

interactions: 2000 random principal/rate/tenure triples through Money and its add/subtract/multiply helpers
Decimal exponent assertion on every resulting value
entries.notes: The AC says 'when a schedule is computed'. No schedule exists in group A (later epic), so this is verified on Money and its arithmetic helpers as the available proxy, plus the D-G wire serializer. Money exposes no divide() yet, so EMI-style division is not exercisable.

interactions: runtime float/bool/non-finite rejection probes on Money and Money.multiply
entries.notes: CR-001 (Money accepted NaN) and CR-002 (float guard ignored arithmetic) both independently verified closed. The guard's negative controls are what make the zero-count meaningful rather than vacuous.

interactions: independent grep scan of frontend/src/types/money.ts for float-arithmetic tokens

observed.value_held_as: Decimal (decimal.js), private readonly, never a JS number

entries.notes: The single scan hit is decimal.js's Decimal.prototype.toFixed on a Decimal receiver, returning a string - not Number.prototype.toFixed and not arithmetic. format() uses only string split/replace. No integer minor-unit representation and no scale/unscale helper, per D-J.

interactions: type and attribute introspection of the classify result and the DelinquencyBucket enum

observed.reason: No HTTP surface in group A can raise an unhandled exception. GET /health takes no input and cannot fail, and no other route is registered, so a 500 is not reachable black-box on this app. The claim that X-Request-ID survives the 500 path (CorrelationIdMiddleware installed outside ServerErrorMiddleware) could not be independently confirmed at runtime.
observed.rationale: Not an acceptance criterion of E15-S1/E9-S1/E11-S1 and not one of the three frozen api_checks. Recorded untested rather than passed.

observed.reason: The only error reachable over HTTP is Starlette's default 404, which does not route through register_exception_handlers' AppError mapping. No AppError-raising route exists in group A, so the {error, detail, context} envelope is not runtime-verifiable. The 404 path does correctly echo X-Request-ID and emit a JSON log line carrying it.

accepted, reflected in full in the response header and written in full to the log. No length cap. Log line stayed valid JSON.

deterministic_gates_reproduced.backend_mypy: exit 0 - no issues in 12 source files

performance_ratchet.reason: No recorded baseline exists - group A is the first group in a greenfield build, so there is nothing to regress against. Per the ratchet rule this is a WARN, not a FAIL.

slo_error_rate.reason: observability.enabled is not configured for this project and no /metrics endpoint exists in group A. No 5xx was observed on any probe; the only non-2xx responses were a deliberate 404 and three deliberate 400s from malformed-header probes, all 4xx and therefore outside the error-rate SLO.

accessibility.reason: The contract declares no accessibility_checks and there is no frontend route served by this backend in group A.

security_gate.note: Not folded in by this instance. This is the functional verdict only. Findings O1, O2 and O3 in the report are handed to the security reviewer. Per the evaluator KEY RULES the overall gate verdict is FAIL if the security verdict reports pass:false, regardless of this functional PASS. The stored security-verdict.json predates HEAD and was deliberately not read.
